entries.heading: (a) The
ancestors: DIVISION B—EMERGENCY APPROPRIATIONS FOR CORONAVIRUS HEALTH RESPONSE AND AGENCY OPERATIONS
entries.text:
Sec. 13005. (a) The 
head of an agency may waive the provisions of section 2326(b) of title 
10, United States Code, with respect to a contract of such agency if the 
head of the agency determines that the waiver is necessary due to the 
national emergency for the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19).

    (b) In this section, the term ``head of an 
agency'' has the meaning given that term in section 2302(2) of title 10, 
United States Code.
